name: mediawiki/core
description: Free software wiki application developed by the Wikimedia Foundation and others

suggest.ext-bcmath: Increased performance of some operations. Required especially on 32 bit machines. This or ext-gmp are needed for scrambling Temporary Accounts.
suggest.ext-curl: Faster HTTP services, e.g. when using InstantCommons, Swift, or Etcd.
suggest.ext-gmp: Increased performance of some operations. Required especially on 32 bit machines. This or ext-bcmath are needed for scrambling Temporary Accounts.
suggest.ext-igbinary: Enables use of igbinary for serialisation.
suggest.ext-imagick: Enables use of imagemagick for image manipulation.
suggest.ext-memcached: Enables use of Memcached for caching purposes.
suggest.ext-mysqli: Enable the MySQL and MariaDB database type for MediaWiki.
suggest.ext-pdo: Enable the SQLite database type for MediaWiki.
suggest.ext-pgsql: Enable the PostgreSQL database type for MediaWiki.
suggest.ext-posix: Enable CLI concurrent processing, e.g. for runJobs.php.
suggest.ext-pcntl: Enable CLI concurrent processing, e.g. for runJobs.php and rebuildLocalisationCache.php.
suggest.ext-readline: Enable CLI history and autocomplete, e.g. for eval.php and other REPLs.
suggest.ext-redis: Enables use of Redis for caching purposes.
suggest.ext-sockets: Enable CLI concurrent processing, e.g. for rebuildLocalisationCache.php.
suggest.ext-wincache: Enables use of WinCache on Windows.
suggest.ext-zlib: Enable use of GZIP compression, e.g. for SqlBagOStuff (ParserCache), $wgCompressRevisions, or $wgUseFileCache.
